detail: resize: PGLeftJaw hole PGLeftJaw_H8_0 off its (u,v) by 14.153
known: Resizing a frame bar (both ends fixed) whose end is shared with another frame bar moves the shared fixed point; the other bar keeps its old length and the solver does not flag a bar between two fixed points, so its local holes no longer sit at (u,v). Needs resizeStandardBlank to refuse moving a fixed shared end; no startup-size budget left in this pack.
